purpose: Teach: 素質/各界/度胸/議事堂/飽和/イニシアチブ/肝要/切り取っ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社員の素質を見極めた
lines.en: Your father had a gift for seeing the real character in people right from the start.
lines.style: Measured, reflective. Soft opening, as if calling up memory. Unhurried pace. The voice of someone who knew him well enough to notice what others missed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは各界の人脈をお持ちだった
lines.en: Yes. He had connections across every field — that was his real strength.
lines.style: Respectful, formal acknowledgment. Slight pause before the personal admission. Speaking from lived experience. Not eulogy, but testimony.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、難局で度胸ある決断をされた
lines.en: Your father made the hard calls when it mattered most. He had the nerve for it.
lines.style: Quieter, more intimate. The cadence of someone who witnessed difficult moments. Slight weight on 'nerve' — admiration for something costly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは議事堂での請願にも自ら立たれた
lines.en: Yes. He stood up for it himself — even went before the Diet to advocate.
lines.style: Steady, factual, but with underlying gravity. The voice of a son recalling his father's public courage. No embellishment, just the plain weight of it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、市場の飽和を予見されてた
lines.en: Your father saw what was coming in the market before anyone else did.
lines.style: Gentle observation, like watching someone remember a warning that came true. Slow, deliberate. The sadness of foresight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは業界のイニシアチブを取った
lines.en: Yes. He didn't wait — he took the lead when the industry needed it.
lines.style: Calm acceptance of what had to be done. Warm, but not sentimental. The voice of someone who learned what leadership looked like by watching.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、経営で肝要な視点を持たれた
lines.en: Your father had something most people never develop — the right way of thinking about business.
lines.style: Tender respect. Slow opening. Pause before naming the quality. The voice of someone who spent years understanding what his father actually knew.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新聞記事を切り取って研究された
lines.en: Yes. He'd cut out newspaper articles, study them carefully. That's how he stayed sharp.
lines.style: Warm, almost gentle. A small, specific detail that reveals the man. Slight smile in the voice. The remembered image of his father working.
